QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Survivors
QuestInfo.0:
The village bursts into a celebration, grateful not only to have survived but to have beaten the Giant Shadow. Sanaan, unaware of what the Giant Shadow was, congratulates Einar, who quietly departs.
Alika is sure the girls in her dream were Blanche and Julieta. She says it's her destiny to find out who is behind all this and to find Blanche. Then she asks you to join her.
